Subject: LumenWorks MAP: template & kickoff draft

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the demo last week. As discussed, I’m sharing our Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template to accelerate the evaluation and lock in a realistic close timeline. I attached a lightweight Google Doc template (MAP_Template_v1.gdoc) and a 2-slide kickoff stub.

High-level proposal (editable in the doc):
- Week 0 (1–3 days): access + security review (test account + IP allowlist)
- Week 1: integration & POC (sample queries + perf baseline)
- Week 2: validation (quality checks + acceptance prompts)
- Week 3–4: scaling test & procurement/contract steps

Proposed acceptance criteria (we can refine in the MAP):
- Functional: sample endpoints return acceptable precision/recall on the validation set
- Performance: p99 inference latency <= 300ms under target load (TBD)
- Security: SOC2 evidence collection complete for the items listed in the doc

Can you confirm the stakeholders we should include (legal/procurement/security)? Also, are you available for a 45-minute kickoff tomorrow (Tue 5/19) or Wed morning? I’ll lock the slot once we confirm.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP_Template_v1.gdoc], [Attachment: LumenWorks_MAP_45min_kickoff_slides.pptx]

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
